mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tightening labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 520000 million dollars, it signals overheating consumer demand that may lead to inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 520000.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising by at least 0.25% in the last 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases by >=0.25% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong job growth (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly tightening labor market, which may lead to inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.6%.

mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS decreases by at least 0.25% month-over-month.
